mapper.insert: INSERT INTO design_submissions(id, full_name, address, phone, note, image_url, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{fullName}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{note}, #{imageUrl}, 'pending_confirmation', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE design_submissions SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE design_submissions SET deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
